MappingFields.Name: first_name
MappingFields.Description: Optional update field. Empty/null values keep existing data unchanged.

MappingFields.Name: last_name
MappingFields.Description: Optional update field. Empty/null values keep existing data unchanged.

MappingFields.Name: adfs_login
MappingFields.Description: Mandatory for active accounts. Unique attribute. Not available for field comparison in account update. Cleared on delete to enable reuse.

MappingFields.Name: email
MappingFields.Description: Mandatory for active accounts. Unique attribute. Cleared on delete to enable reuse.

MappingFields.Name: code
MappingFields.Description: Primary account key. Required for creation and correlation. No updates possible.

MappingFields.Name: ends_on
MappingFields.Description: The ends_on property is determined in the account life cycle scripts: null for active accounts, yesterday for delete. The mapping should be None.
